name: qubit-hud
label: Qubit HUD
description: Qubit HUD — one read-only page for the agent's vitals, in 7 panels: Health, Sessions, Cron, Models, Skills, Plugins and Costs. Every panel reads a `GET /api/hud/<panel>` collector over the same stores the CLI and voice surfaces read; a panel whose collector is not installed says so with its own status instead of drawing an empty chart.
